profile_girth.label: Profile girth
profile_girth.help: Developed width of a profile (flashings, gutters)

developed_area.label: Developed area
developed_area.help: True sloped or unfolded area (roofs, stairs)

wall_area_net.label: Room wall area, net
wall_area_net.help: Rooms only, less doors and windows

skirting_length.label: Room skirting length
skirting_length.help: Rooms only, perimeter less door widths

mass.label: Mass
mass.help: Reported in the model, if any

family_name.label: Family name
family_name.help: Authoring-tool family, e.g. a Revit family

element_type.label: Element type
element_type.help: Dictionary term from the type name

space_type.label: Room type
space_type.help: Dictionary term from the room name

openings.label: Openings
openings.help: Doors, windows and voids in the element

faces.label: Faces
faces.help: Sides of the element (walls: side a and b, with the room on each)

children.label: Parts
children.help: Parts of an assembly (stair flights, roof slabs)

building.label: Building
building.help: Whole-building values; the log says whether each is from the model or derived

gross_floor_area.label: Gross floor area
gross_floor_area.help: Building: floor slab plan areas, or the model's own value

net_floor_area.label: Net floor area
net_floor_area.help: Building: sum of room floor areas, or the model's own value

embedded.label: Elements passing through
embedded.help: Columns and beams through a slab or wall

filling_class.label: Filling class
filling_class.help: IFC class of the door or window in an opening

keys.label: Line key
keys.help: The values that split the source line, e.g. Line key › Type name

formula.unknown: Unknown name {label}. Pick one from Names.

hints.rule_set: How quantities are measured. Changes the numbers.
hints.classification: Codes, grouping and item texts. Never changes a number.
hints.dictionary: What the names in your models mean.
hints.federation: Which discipline's model owns which elements when several models go into one BoQ.
hints.resolution: How names are matched to meanings, and when to ask.

home.title: Library
home.intro: Your firm's measuring knowledge, as data you own: rule sets, classifications and dictionaries, versioned and shared by every project.
home.projectIntro: Presets that belong to this project only, such as its own dictionary or a patch on a company rule set.
home.emptyProject: This project has no presets of its own.

preset.draftProblems: Draft · {n, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}
preset.archivedNote: This preset is archived: it is hidden from pickers and can't be edited. BoQs that used it keep their numbers.
preset.detailsHint: The name and notes people see in the Library and in the BoQ setup.
preset.archiveBody: It disappears from the Library and from every picker. BoQs and saved versions that used it keep their numbers and their copy of it.

create.name: Name
create.basedOnHint: Free text, for your own reference, e.g. the rulebook you follow. boqlet doesn't check it against any standard.

modeHints.empty: Start with nothing and add what you need.
modeHints.copy: An independent copy of a version. Later changes to the original don't reach it.
modeHints.patch: Store only your changes. It follows the original's future versions.

create.notAllowed: You can view and pick presets here, but creating them is for library editors (and, in a project, its leads and estimators).

edit.draftOver: Version {n} stays in use until the draft is published.
edit.noDraft: Version {n} is the latest. Start a draft to change it.
edit.system: System presets are read-only. Make a copy to change one.
edit.discardBody: Its changes are lost. The published versions stay as they are.
edit.discardBodyNoVersion: Its changes are lost. The preset has no published version, so it stays empty until you start again.

versions.hint: Published versions never change. Tick two to compare them.
versions.readOnly: Read-only. Restore it as a draft to work from it.
versions.restoreBody: The current draft is replaced by version {n}'s document.
versions.diffSame: The two versions are the same.
versions.diffSummary: {added, plural, one {# line added} other {# lines added}}, {removed, plural, one {# line removed} other {# lines removed}}
versions.diffSkip: {n, plural, one {# unchanged line} other {# unchanged lines}}

usage.none: No BoQ uses this preset yet.
